name: users/admin.py
summary: Django admin configuration registering and customizing the admin interface for User and Profile models
purpose: Enables secure back-office management of user accounts and profile data through Django's built-in administrative interface, extending base admin classes to tailor list views, forms, and permissions for the users app
responsibilities: Registers the User and Profile models with the Django admin site
Extends django.contrib.auth.admin.UserAdmin to customize user management behavior
Configures ProfileAdmin to control how profile data is displayed and edited
Defines admin-specific presentation logic such as list displays, filters, and search fields
Isolates administrative concerns from models and business logic
inputs: User and Profile model definitions from users.models
Base Django admin and auth admin classes
Staff/superuser HTTP requests to the Django admin interface
outputs: Customized CRUD admin pages for User and Profile models
Back-office list views, detail forms, and admin actions
architecture_notes: Follows Django's app-centric modular pattern by co-locating admin configuration within the users app. Uses class inheritance from ModelAdmin and UserAdmin to encapsulate admin-specific behavior without polluting the model layer. Acts as a presentation adapter between the domain models and Django's admin framework, keeping administrative routing and UI configuration separate from core application logic.
improvements: Use @admin.register class decorators for explicit and cleaner model registration
Add ProfileInline to UserAdmin for unified user-and-profile management on a single page
Define fieldsets on both admins to improve form organization and UX
Add custom list_filters and search_fields tailored to business requirements
Implement admin-level permission checks or audit logging for sensitive user data modifications
Consider moving admin classes to a dedicated admin/ sub-package if configuration grows complex
